title: Marrakech: Souks & Sahara Dunes
summary: The medina's souks and riads, then over the High Atlas to a private Sahara camp — camel silhouettes and a sky with no ambient light for a hundred miles.
highlights: A private guide through the medina's souks
A night in a private Sahara camp

itinerary.title: Arrive in Marrakech
itinerary.description: Settle into a riad, then a private guide through the medina's souks.

itinerary.title: Gardens & Atlas foothills
itinerary.description: Jardin Majorelle in the morning, then depart for the mountains.

itinerary.title: Crossing the High Atlas
itinerary.description: A dramatic 4x4 crossing, overnighting in a Berber guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Into the Sahara
itinerary.description: Camel trek to a private desert camp for the night.

itinerary.title: Return to Marrakech
itinerary.description: A scenic drive back, with time to revisit the souks.

itinerary.title: Depart Marrakech
itinerary.description: A final breakfast before your transfer to the airport.

included: 6 nights across a riad, mountain guesthouse & desert camp
The camel trek and desert camp
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
